name: How long does a typical cabinet refinishing project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical cabinet refinishing project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a cabinet refinishing project depends on the size of your kitchen, the complexity of the cabinet design, and the chosen finish. Typically, a project can take anywhere from one to three weeks. Factors such as the need for extensive repairs or specialized finishes can extend this timeline. We prioritize efficient project management to minimize disruption to your home in the East Bay area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cabinet refinishing typically takes one to three weeks, depending on kitchen size and project complexity.
